popup_empty_history.message: Your latest summaries will appear here.

popup_login_completing.message: Finish signing in from the Google window...

modal_truncated.message: Very long content: the summary covers only the first part of the page.

modal_unsupported_output.message: Output format not supported in this version.

note_video_available.message: This page also contains a video.

note_video_not_accessible.message: The video on this page isn't accessible (protected stream or no subtitles), so the page text was summarized instead.

note_video_needs_premium.message: Summarizing the video requires the Premium plan, so the page text was summarized instead.

note_video_too_long.message: The video is too long to transcribe, so the page text was summarized instead.

note_video_skipped_live.message: A live stream is in progress (partial content), so the page text was summarized instead.

note_captions_failed.message: The video subtitles couldn't be downloaded.

note_stt_failed.message: The video audio couldn't be transcribed.

note_captions_translated.message: Subtitles are in another language: the summary is translated.

note_transcript_truncated.message: Very long video: the summary covers only the first part of the transcript.

err_paywall.message: This page is behind a paywall: the content isn't accessible without a subscription to the provider. Sign in on the site and try again.

err_login_wall.message: This content requires signing in to the site. Log in on the page and try again.

err_consent_wall.message: Dismiss the cookie/consent banner on the page and try again.

err_canvas_doc.message: This document (for example Google Docs or Office online) can't be read by the extension. Export it to PDF or open the published (HTML) version.

err_too_long.message: This content is too long for a reliable summary. Try a shorter section or page.

err_bot_challenge.message: The page is protected by an anti-bot check. Open it in the browser and try again.

err_invalid_response.message: This content couldn't be summarized (it may not contain usable text, or it isn't allowed by the policies).

err_auth_required.message: You need to sign in to use this extension.

err_insufficient_text.message: This page doesn't contain enough text to summarize.

err_timeout.message: The summary took too long. Please try again.

err_network.message: Couldn't reach the service. Check your connection and try again.

err_generic.message: The summary couldn't be generated. Please try again shortly.

err_premium_required.message: Summarizing videos without subtitles is reserved for the Premium plan.

err_unsupported_media.message: Video not supported: the source isn't accessible (protected stream, DRM, or a non-direct format).

err_media_too_large.message: The video is too large to summarize right now. Try a shorter one.

err_no_speech.message: No speech was recognized in the video.

err_live_stream.message: This is a live stream: subtitles are partial and the content isn't complete yet. Try again once the recording is available.

err_video_not_accessible.message: The video on this page isn't accessible (protected stream or DRM) and has no subtitles, so it can't be summarized.

err_video_too_long_no_captions.message: This video is too long to transcribe and has no subtitles. For now, long videos are supported only when subtitles are available.

err_captions_failed.message: The video subtitles couldn't be downloaded. Reload the page and try again.

err_transcribe_timeout.message: Transcribing the video is taking too long. Try again in a few minutes.

err_blocked_url.message: The video source isn't publicly reachable.

err_insufficient_content.message: This page doesn't contain enough content to summarize.

err_transcribe_generic.message: The video couldn't be transcribed. Please try again shortly.

summarypage_load_error.message: Something went wrong while loading the summary.

summarypage_truncated.message: Long content: the summary covers only the first part.

sw_notif_login_message.message: Open the extension and sign in to continue.

err_quota_reached.message: Summary limit reached. Upgrade to Premium to continue.

err_transcript_unavailable.message: No transcript available for this video.

err_pdf_too_long.message: This PDF is too long for a reliable summary.

err_pdf_no_text.message: This PDF has no selectable text (it is likely a scan or an image).

popup_login_subtitle.message: Sign in with Google to use $1 and get smart summaries.
